text: At its meeting held on February 25, 2020, the Toronto Police Services Board (Board) was in receipt of a report from Chief of Police Mark Saunders, with regard to Establishing a Community Police Office in Lawrence Heights. The Board received the report and I would like to forward a copy to the City of Toronto Executive Committee. A copy of the Board Minute P34/2020 regarding this matter is attached.
The Executive Committee received this Item for information.
